sections.content: Use the pretérito indefinido for completed past events, especially when the time period is finished or a completed event is located in the past. Common forms include *aprendí*, *terminó*, *recordamos* and *hicieron*.

items.english: I learned a lot in the course.

sections.content: *Termino* (I finish, present) and *terminó* (he/she finished, preterite) are separated only by an accent mark and a shift in subject — lose the accent and you've changed both the tense and who's doing the finishing.
